title: StockScreener - A stock screening platform I'm looking for early testers to challenge
author: Rectorato
selftext:
I've built a stock screening/ranking system and before I make it public I'd like to have a few people with a quantitative or systematic investing background try to break it.

The system combines several stock factors into a ranking and then generates a detailed explanation of the result.

What I want to validate is not whether the UI looks good, but whether the underlying logic is defensible.

I'd particularly like someone to challenge:

* factor selection
* weighting
* normalization/ranking
* treatment of missing or unusual data
* possible unintended biases
* whether the final score actually adds useful information
* cases where the system produces a result that looks obviously wrong

I'm deliberately looking for criticism at this stage.

The platform is currently private and I'm looking for a few people willing to test it and give me candid feedback.

I'm not selling anything and I'm not asking for investment opinions or stock picks — I want to test the screening methodology itself.  
I bought some suggested stocks and currently I've a P&L of 5% and a win rate of 59%  
Backtest inside the app to show this.
